claims.original_summary: Baseline definition includes motor, vocal and impairment components; total range 0–100.
Primary outcome definition is total motor plus phonic tic severity, range 0–50, prior-week clinician assessment.
Baseline module reports eight participants; no YGTSS-measure-specific denominator is returned.
Eight enrolled and eight analyzed are reported for the primary outcome.
Overall flow is eight started, eight completed and zero not completed; later visit completeness is not established.
Protocol plans greater-than-30-percent individual improvement and four of eight responders as its threshold; these are not observed results.
A post-primary-treatment option refers to YGTSS motor-scale improvement; this does not establish a universal score definition.
Comparator is preoperative; separate baseline visit is required only when screening assessments occurred more than 45 days before surgery.
Lead surgery may be staged. IPGs are placed approximately one month after all leads; first three physiology months are explicitly post-IPG.
Programming is planned during months 4–9, with day-270/month-nine assessment, ±14-day visit window and 30 days stable settings; data collection spans two to three outpatient days.
Posted group narrative places measurement nine months after DBS initiation without defining activation versus implantation.
Temporary open-loop settings are permitted if a suitable control signal has not been found; uniform closed-loop exposure cannot be assumed.

General feasibility plan is descriptive/primarily individual; a manuscript paragraph names signed-rank baseline/month-nine comparisons, median change and Spearman correlation with FDR on correlation p values. No numerical aggregate estimator is provided.
Cover date is 2021-12-20, upload 2026-09-24T11:52. Manuscript paragraph has no separately verified addition date or named manuscript.
Parameter type NUMBER, no analyses/dispersion object returned by projection. No compatible published aggregate paired change or responder count is established by these inspected sources.
Enrollment through follow-up approximately two years after lead surgery; non-systematic assessment. A common complete two-year observation period is not verified.
Affected-person totals are serious 3/8, other 8/8, deaths 0/8. Categories may overlap and do not establish device causation.
Scheduled AE log and investigator/DSMB review are planned; they do not override the posted non-systematic assessment label.
